reason: A dsh plugin that greets users at the start of sessions, remembers their name and greeting style locally, and adapts greeting wording and language.

summaries.zh: 在每次会话开始时主动问候用户，并在本地记住姓名和问候风格以提供个性化问候的 dsh 插件。
summaries.en: A dsh plugin that greets users at the start of each session and locally remembers their name and greeting style for personalized greetings.

capabilities: Injects a greeting instruction into the agent pipeline at session start
Persists the user's name and greeting preferences in a local dsh file
Registers tools for remembering the user's name and changing greeting style
Can trigger one model generation proactively per new session
